items.markdown:
Several great board and dice games capture the feel of Yahtzee through rolling, rerolling, push-your-luck mechanics, or pattern matching:[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2u9zkMijpm8&t=5)

### Roll-and-Write & Pattern Matching

- **[Qwixx](https://boardgamegeek.com/blog/10104/blogpost/162558/5-games-better-than-yahtzee):** A fast-paced filler game where you roll colored and white dice to cross numbers off sequential rows on your score sheet.[[1]](https://boardgamegeek.com/blog/10104/blogpost/162558/5-games-better-than-yahtzee)[[2]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/great-modern-yahtzee-alternatives/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ho2-kFDH_6Y&t=57)
- **That’s Pretty Clever (Ganz schön clever):** An optimization puzzle where you draft colored dice to trigger clever, multi-step scoring chains on your sheet.[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/great-modern-yahtzee-alternatives/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lVJ1ID22RRA&t=1)
- **Kismet:** A direct spiritual relative to Yahtzee that uses specialized dice marked with red and black symbols to make scoring more challenging and varied.

### Push-Your-Luck & Party Dice Games

- **Farkle:** A classic high-risk dice game where you roll to bank points, deciding whether to stop or push your luck by rolling remaining dice (and risking losing your turn's points).[[1]](https://www.donteatthemeeples.com/five-games-to-replace-yahtzee/)
- **Liar’s Dice (Pirates Dice):** A bluffing and deduction game where players hide their dice under cups and guess how many of a certain number are hidden around the table.[[1]](https://boardgamegeek.com/blog/10104/blogpost/162558/5-games-better-than-yahtzee)[[2]](https://thetabletopfamily.com/best-board-games-like-yahtzee/)
- **Stuck in the Mud (Drop Dead):** A quick push-your-luck game using five dice where rolling specific numbers like 2 or 5 gets "stuck" in the mud, testing your nerve to keep going.[[1]](https://www.dicegamedepot.com/dice-n-games-blog/tired-of-yahtzee-here-are-six-familyfriendly-dice-games-to-try-instead/)
- **Spots:** A light, push-your-luck card and dice game about matching and rolling dice to fill out cartoon dog cards.[[1]](https://www.donteatthemeeples.com/five-games-to-replace-yahtzee/)[[2]](https://thetabletopfamily.com/best-board-games-like-yahtzee/)

### Combat & Thematic Dice Games

- **Dice Throne:** Often described as "Combat Yahtzee," players roll and reroll a set of unique character dice up to three times to activate special attacks and defend against opponents in a head-to-head duel.[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/groups/132851767828/posts/10161195329552829/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lVJ1ID22RRA&t=1)
- **King of Tokyo:** A high-energy game where you roll custom dice up to three times to gain points, heal, or attack other giant monsters fighting for control of Tokyo.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lVJ1ID22RRA&t=1)[[2]](https://boardgamegeek.com/blog/10104/blogpost/162558/5-games-better-than-yahtzee)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2u9zkMijpm8&t=5)
- **Elder Sign:** A cooperative horror game where players roll custom dice to match patterns and solve investigations at a museum before ancient evils awaken.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lVJ1ID22RRA&t=1)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2u9zkMijpm8&t=5)

To help narrow down the best choice for you, tell me:

- Are you looking for a **casual family game** or a **strategy/combat game**?
- How **many players** usually join your game nights?
